# Bundled front-end libraries

Shipped inside the package so that `pankegg_app` works without internet access.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plotly.min.js` | [plotly.js](https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js) | 2.35.2 | MIT |
| `bootstrap.min.css`, `bootstrap.bundle.min.js` (includes Popper) | [Bootstrap](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap) | 5.3.3 | MIT |

Each file keeps its own copyright header.
